zones.description: One entry per Cloudflare DNS zone this host should keep updated.

api_token.description: Scoped Cloudflare API token with Zone:DNS:Edit permission for this zone. Generate at dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens.

zone_id.description: Cloudflare Zone ID (32-character hex string) shown on the zone's Overview page.

subdomains.description: DNS records to update within this zone. Add one object per hostname.

name.description: Subdomain label to update. Use empty string "" for the apex/root domain, "www" for www.<domain>, etc.

proxied.description: Enable Cloudflare proxy (CDN, WAF, DDoS protection) for this record. When true the real IP is hidden.

update_ipv4.description: Update A records with the current public IPv4 address. Disable if this host has no public IPv4.

update_ipv6.description: Update AAAA records with the current public IPv6 address. Enable only if the host has a stable public IPv6.

purge_unknown_records.description: Delete A/AAAA records in managed zones that were not created by this tool. Use with caution on shared zones.

ttl.description: DNS record TTL in seconds (minimum 60). Set to 1 to let Cloudflare manage it automatically.
